summary: The public contract permits at most 100 forwarded arguments, so the complete legal domain is too small for an honest runtime-scaling verdict; each wrapper invocation forwards those arguments once and otherwise performs constant work.

workload_bound.source_constraint: The args array contains between one and 100 integer values.

replacement_checks.evidence: Each invocation stores one rest array of a values, creates one Promise and one callback closure, and calls fn once with one spread that forwards the same a values after the callback.

Authored cases cover one, several, and exactly 100 arguments; synchronous and asynchronous callbacks; resolution, callback rejection, synchronous throws, object results, error precedence, and first-settlement behavior.
